text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Japanese Derby, and
Gold City
is fired up more than ever to
rewrite her
reputation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I warn her that reputations can't be
overturned
with just one race, but she
doesn't take my advice
to heart.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити heads into the race to earn
the title of
Derby champion.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
